name: Compute Shader Triangle Voxelization
definition: A compute shader technique for voxelizing large triangles by iterating over a 2D bounding box in the plane of the triangle and testing for collisions, designed to handle triangles that span many voxels more efficiently than per-voxel rasterization.
summary: Compute Shader Triangle Voxelization is a GPU technique that voxelizes large triangles by iterating over their 2D bounding box and solving the plane equation, offering precise solid voxelization without relying on hardware rasterization pipelines.
